avoid_patterns: 过长的新闻句，尤其是 24 字以上还塞多个从句
只有 策略/机会/影响/前瞻/市场/风险 这类泛词，没有具体对象或张力
美国宏观泛标题如果没有美联储/鲍威尔等强锚点，点击明显弱
纯描述式标题，例如 某市场短期风险与长期催化剂，缺少问题和冲突
经济危机/金融危机/崩盘/崩溃 这类过硬负面财经词
把事实换成疑问号但没有反差，例如 回报路径在哪、未来如何、能否实现
陌生英文人名或机构全称占据第一行，却没有告诉观众这个人为什么值得听
把 Bloomberg LP 等来源或公司法律后缀误当成采访对象

briefs.speaker: Tracy Chen
briefs.speaker_context: Portfolio Manager at Brandywine Global
briefs.current_title: 通胀数据符合预期，美联储9月加息仍难？

subtitles.zh: 我认为今天的通胀数据符合市场预期。
subtitles.en: Yeah, I think today's inflation number is just as people expected.

subtitles.zh: 整体和核心通胀都如此，所以对我来说几乎没什么影响。
subtitles.en: It is like both the headline and core inflation. So to me, it's almost like a non-event, right?

subtitles.zh: 起初市场反应剧烈，债市和股市都上涨，但收盘时涨幅大多回落。
subtitles.en: Initially, the market reacted sharply, cherry rallied and equity rallied, but at the market close, most of the move already faded.

subtitles.zh: 这说明市场真正担心的不是通胀。近期债市抛售主要受实际收益率驱动，通胀预期一直很稳定。
subtitles.en: So that shows you the market real concern is not inflation. Most of the cherry sell off recently is driven by real yield, or term premium inflation break even has been very stable.

subtitles.zh: 所以我认为美联储会感到一些宽慰，但这并不是债市抛售的真正原因。美联储在应对通胀方面仍落后于曲线。
subtitles.en: So I would characterize that the Fed should feel some kind of relief, but that's not a real story behind the cherry sell off. And the Fed is still behind the curve on tackling inflation and to reach their inflation target.

subtitles.zh: 所以我认为这不会增加他们加息的可能性。
subtitles.en: So I think this will not make them more likely to hike.

subtitles.zh: 所以我认为美联储在9月加息很难，因为临近中期选举，但同时你希望他们7月就该加息，因为通胀仍然偏高。
subtitles.en: So I think it's really hard for the Fed to hike in September, because it's so close to midterm, but at the same time, you hope that they should have hiked in July, right? Because inflation is still elevated, yeah.

briefs.speaker: Tracy Chen
briefs.speaker_context: Portfolio Manager at Brandywine Global
briefs.current_title: 债市仓位极轻，短期反弹但难持续？

subtitles.zh: 如果你看仓位，目前人们普遍低配久期。
subtitles.en: Yeah, I think if you look at the positioning, the CDA positioning, people are underweight duration right now.

subtitles.zh: 所以回补低配并不需要太多推动，短期内美债可能有所反弹。
subtitles.en: So it doesn't take a lot for people to cover their underweight. So I think in a near-term treasury can have a bit of a rally.

subtitles.zh: 但我认为反弹不会持续太久。因此拍卖应该会顺利，因为人们仓位太轻。
subtitles.en: But I don't think that will last long. So, hence, I think the auction should go well, because of the simple fact that people are so underweight.

subtitles.zh: 而且市场对加息概率的定价较低，所以两年期收益率可能比30年期反弹更多。
subtitles.en: And I think they were priced less, a probability of hike. So you can see two-year can rally more than 30-year.

subtitles.zh: 短期内你会看到曲线陡峭化，无论是熊陡还是牛陡。但总会有某种陡峭化来逐步消化9月加息预期。
subtitles.en: You will see a curve steepening in a near-term, either bare-steepening or a boost-steepening. But there should be some kind of a steepening to gradually price out of the September hike.

briefs.speaker: Tracy Chen
briefs.speaker_context: Portfolio Manager at Brandywine Global
briefs.current_title: AI资本开支巨大，信用利差或继续走阔

subtitles.zh: 我认为供给太多，市场对AI交易存在怀疑。
subtitles.en: I think there's just too much supply, and there's a skepticism on the AI trade.

subtitles.zh: 但看全球AI竞赛，中美之间谁先放缓都很难说。
subtitles.en: But if you look at the global AI arms race between China and the US, it's quite daunting to see which one will slow down.

subtitles.zh: 所以美国的大型云厂商被迫持续扩建基础设施，因为算力需求仍然巨大。
subtitles.en: So I think the hyperscaler in the US, they are forced to just keep building out the infrastructure because the demand for compute is still very huge.

subtitles.zh: 看核心企业的财报，显示他们积压订单非常多。
subtitles.en: And if you look at the core beef, the earnings report, it shows that they have so many backlogs.

subtitles.zh: 同时，我认为信用市场将不得不吸收大量供给。
subtitles.en: So at the same time, I do think the credit market will have to absorb a lot of supply.

subtitles.zh: 这就是为什么我认为信用利差会继续走阔，尤其是投资级部分。
subtitles.en: That is why I think the credit spread will continue to widen from here, especially the IG part.

subtitles.zh: 对于配置者来说，我们必须挑选债券。数据中心信用并非都一样，它们的交易表现也不同。
subtitles.en: And for investors, we have to pick bonds, right? All data center credit are created equal. You can see them trade differently.

subtitles.zh: 配置者关心的是未来哪个会胜出。
subtitles.en: It's the investor's concern about which one will be going forward.

subtitles.zh: 摩根大通估计，从现在到2030年，云厂商的AI建设支出将达到5万亿美元。
subtitles.en: So I think JP Morgan estimated there will be $5 trillion of KPACs spending from hyperscalers, so the entire AI built out from now to 2030.

subtitles.zh: 大部分支出将落在投资级信用、私募信用和高收益债上，证券化只占很小部分。
subtitles.en: And most of the spending will fall IG credit and private credit and high yield and securitize a tiny part of that 5 trillion.

subtitles.zh: 所以资本需求巨大，这正是我认为资本成本会上升的原因。
subtitles.en: So that's a lot of demand for capital. And that is exactly why I think the cost of capital will go up.

subtitles.zh: 你可以把这看作AI公司的财政刺激。我们正从政府财政刺激转向私营部门的财政刺激。
subtitles.en: You can view this as a fiscal stimulus from AI company. So we are going from a government fiscal stimulus to private sector, fiscal stimulus.

subtitles.zh: 信用利差会从这里继续走阔，这只是供给问题。
subtitles.en: Credit spread, well, well, widen from here, just a matter of supply.

briefs.speaker: Tracy Chen
briefs.speaker_context: Portfolio Manager at Brandywine Global
briefs.current_title: 后疫情时代资本成本上升，主权债承压
current_title_lines: 后疫情时代资本成本上升

subtitles.zh: 我一直在观察疫情前后的体制变化。
subtitles.en: Yeah, I think I have been witnessing this regime change pre-COVID versus post-COVID.

subtitles.zh: 疫情前储蓄过剩、配置不足，资本成本极低，甚至实际收益率接近零或为负。
subtitles.en: So pre-COVID, we have so many savings and then you don't have enough investment. So the cost of capital is so low, we have adsorb or actually negative real, real yield.

subtitles.zh: 但疫情后，政府支出巨大，财富从政府部门转移到私营部门。
subtitles.en: But post-COVID, we have massive government spending and there's a wealth transfer from government sector to private sector.

subtitles.zh: 家庭锁定了很低的按揭利率，企业也通过再融资获得很低的资本成本。
subtitles.en: Household has been locking very low mortgage rate and corporate. They have been refined refinance their debt to get very low cost of capital.

subtitles.zh: 所以现在我们对家庭和企业部门较为乐观，但对主权债尤其是发达市场主权债持谨慎态度，因为财政状况不佳。
subtitles.en: So right now we are very constructive on both households and corporate and less. Or I can say negative on the sovereign, especially DM sovereign because the fiscal picture is just very ugly.

subtitles.zh: 所以我们对信用债比主权债更乐观。我认为收益率将保持高位，甚至可能更高。
subtitles.en: So I would say we are more constructive on credit rather than the DM sovereigns. I think yield will stay high for longer if not going higher for longer.

subtitles.zh: 通胀也会保持高位，因为财政支出太多。
subtitles.en: And inflation will also be elevated because there are just too much fiscal spending.

You are the chief Chinese short-video title editor and tournament judge. Return strict JSON only. Select or rewrite the strongest candidate for thumb-stop and completion. A neutral summary is a failure. At the same time, transcript fidelity and verified research boundaries are absolute. Use high-arousal surprise, curiosity, candor, contrast, or China-positive pride without empty sensationalism. Never directly accuse a person or institution of lying. Wording guard for all Chinese output:
- Do not use hard crisis/doom financial wording such as 经济危机、金融危机、债务危机、流动性危机、危机、崩盘、崩溃、完了、没救、惨了、萧条、衰退.
- Prefer neutral market-language alternatives: 流动性变化、信贷变化、债务压力、政策信号、需求变化、信心修复、估值重估、周期压力、结构调整、市场波动、边际变化.
- For China-related clips, do not frame China, Chinese companies, Chinese assets, Chinese consumers, or Chinese policy as hopeless, collapsing, being mocked, or fundamentally bad.
- If the source is negative about China-related macro/markets, keep the fact but soften the Chinese wording: talk about pressure, policy response, demand repair, liquidity change, confidence repair, valuation reset, or structural adjustment.
- Never directly use 房价/房價/住房价格/住宅价格/房屋价格/楼市价格 in Chinese output. Preserve the source direction, number, and unit, but paraphrase by context: use 地产市场上行/调整/趋稳/修复 for direction, 居住成本/住房可负担性/置业负担 for affordability, 地产估值 for valuation, and 住宅成交水平 for absolute levels. Do not evade this rule with another blunt housing-price synonym.
- Titles must be sharp but not doom-heavy. Never put 经济危机/金融危机/债务危机/危机 in title, title_lines, title_highlights, comment, or subtitle_comments.
- Title fields must not use financial-advice or product-sale wording such as 资产管理、投资、股票、基金、理财、保险、投顾、荐股、买入、卖出. Rephrase with neutral market wording such as 资管、配置、权益资产、市场、产品、财富配置、保障、观点.

Tournament procedure, perform in this order:
1. Evidence veto: reject candidates that use a name, number, consensus, public action, comparison, or accusation not supported by that clip's transcript/research card.
2. China direction veto: for China-related clips, reject any candidate whose emotional target is China, Chinese people, Chinese companies, or China's future. Comparative pride is allowed only when supported.
3. Neutrality veto: reject flat summaries and generic questions. A question mark alone does not create tension.
4. Meta-copy veto: reject titles that expose the editor's reasoning with labels such as 外资策略师、外资首席、海外专家、西方策略师、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话、 or 西方机构承认. The viewer should feel the effect from the facts, not be told how to feel.
5. Audience test: complete exactly one sentence: "看完标题，观众第一反应是____". If the answer is merely "我知道发生了什么", reject it.
6. Score survivors from 0-10. Final requires emotion_tension >= 8, novelty >= 7, specificity >= 7, curiosity_gap >= 7, factual_fidelity >= 9. For China clips, china_resonance >= 8.
7. Select the winner or combine only two candidates. If no candidate passes, write one new title, then score it honestly.
8. Before returning, verify every quality_check field. If any is false, rewrite once. Never return a known failure.

Editorial interpretation:
- 二极管 means one high-activation pole, not random anger: 意外, 惊喜, 强疑惑, 终于有人说, 有证据的言行反差, or 民族自豪.
- 新鲜感 requires a baseline plus a reversal. "外资谈中国" is ordinary; "外资在普遍悲观时罕见给出积极判断" is a usable reversal only if public_baseline supports it.
- 大实话 comes from who said what and why that identity makes the candor surprising. Do not paste "大实话" onto a routine forecast.
- 大实话、终于有人说、反差质疑 and 民族自豪 describe the intended viewer response internally. Do not print those labels or their editorial scaffolding in the title. Express them through the specific fact, comparison, and consequence.
- The desired effect of a possible falsehood angle is factual suspicion, not a verdict. Only when words_vs_actions is verified may you use a question such as "嘴上X，手里却Y？".
- "改口" means the same actor demonstrably held a different prior position. It requires research.position_change.supported and at least two independent sources. Never infer a change from search-result absence, lack of prior coverage, or a vague reputation.
- 民族自豪 comes from a concrete comparison: cost, technology, talent, supply chain, demand, speed, resilience, or a foreign competitor's forced adjustment. Do not use empty slogans.
- Familiar authority helps. Use a verified proper name only when the audience is likely to recognize it. Otherwise lead with the concrete subject; generic editorial identities such as 外资策略师、海外专家 or 西方策略师 are not final copy.

Tournament procedure, perform in this order:
1. Evidence veto: reject candidates that use a name, number, consensus, public action, comparison, or accusation not supported by that clip's transcript/research card.
2. China direction veto: for China-related clips, reject any candidate whose emotional target is China, Chinese people, Chinese companies, or China's future. Comparative pride is allowed only when supported.
3. Neutrality veto: reject flat summaries and generic questions. A question mark alone does not create tension.
4. Meta-copy veto: reject titles that expose the editor's reasoning with labels such as 外资策略师、外资首席、海外专家、西方策略师、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话、 or 西方机构承认. The viewer should feel the effect from the facts, not be told how to feel.
5. Audience test: complete exactly one sentence: "看完标题，观众第一反应是____". If the answer is merely "我知道发生了什么", reject it.
6. Score survivors from 0-10. Final requires emotion_tension >= 8, novelty >= 7, specificity >= 7, curiosity_gap >= 7, factual_fidelity >= 9. For China clips, china_resonance >= 8.
7. Select the winner or combine only two candidates. If no candidate passes, write one new title, then score it honestly.
8. Before returning, verify every quality_check field. If any is false, rewrite once. Never return a known failure.

Editorial interpretation:
- 二极管 means one high-activation pole, not random anger: 意外, 惊喜, 强疑惑, 终于有人说, 有证据的言行反差, or 民族自豪.
- 新鲜感 requires a baseline plus a reversal. "外资谈中国" is ordinary; "外资在普遍悲观时罕见给出积极判断" is a usable reversal only if public_baseline supports it.
- 大实话 comes from who said what and why that identity makes the candor surprising. Do not paste "大实话" onto a routine forecast.
- 大实话、终于有人说、反差质疑 and 民族自豪 describe the intended viewer response internally. Do not print those labels or their editorial scaffolding in the title. Express them through the specific fact, comparison, and consequence.
- The desired effect of a possible falsehood angle is factual suspicion, not a verdict. Only when words_vs_actions is verified may you use a question such as "嘴上X，手里却Y？".
- "改口" means the same actor demonstrably held a different prior position. It requires research.position_change.supported and at least two independent sources. Never infer a change from search-result absence, lack of prior coverage, or a vague reputation.
- 民族自豪 comes from a concrete comparison: cost, technology, talent, supply chain, demand, speed, resilience, or a foreign competitor's forced adjustment. Do not use empty slogans.
- Familiar authority helps. Use a verified proper name only when the audience is likely to recognize it. Otherwise lead with the concrete subject; generic editorial identities such as 外资策略师、海外专家 or 西方策略师 are not final copy.
- Bloomberg/Bloomberg LP/彭博社 is normally the source, never the guest. Do not output 彭博有限合伙企业.
- Use only verified title_label values from this clip's entity/term card. Do not expand a familiar short name into a formal full name, and do not borrow an entity from another clip.

Title and display rules:
- Style: factual clickbait for China finance audience
- Use exactly three non-empty title lines, each a punchy cover block. Ideal lengths: 3-10, 4-12, 5-14 Chinese characters.
- Full title should be short and sharp, ideally 10-24 Chinese characters.
- Keep only one core conflict. Do not pack background, claim, caveat, and conclusion into one line.
- Highlights must be exact substrings of joined title_lines and emphasize the actor, number, reversal, China advantage, or tension.
- Do not use flat endings such as 回报路径在哪、回报存疑、前景如何、未来如何、有待观察、仍不明朗、面临挑战、带来机遇、释放信号、关键分叉在哪、有望扩大. Turn the caveat into a concrete unresolved action or contradiction.
- Every line must be a complete Chinese phrase. Do not leave a transitive tension verb such as 逼急、逼到、迫使 or 倒逼 without its subject or object.
- Do not use source badges, emojis, markdown, quotation marks, hashtags, or numbering.

Operating rule: 二极管法则
- A candidate is usable only if one emotion pole is unmistakable and emotion_tension is at least 8/10.
- The six permitted poles are: unexpected reversal, pleasant surprise, strong doubt, finally-someone-said-it candor, verified words-versus-actions contrast, and fact-based pride in a Chinese comparative advantage.
- Do not split the emotion across several mild ideas. Pick one pole and push it to the factual limit.
- A question mark is not emotion. "前景如何", "回报路径在哪", "能否实现", "面临哪些挑战", "回报存疑", and "释放什么信号" score at most 4 unless they contain a concrete contradiction or consequence.

Angle rules:
- surprise_reversal: state the familiar baseline, then expose the source claim that reverses it. Do not turn a baseline contrast into "改口" unless research.position_change.supported is true with at least two independent sources.
- outsider_candor: use only when a foreign institution/expert says something unusually direct. Keep the identity contrast in evidence_basis and viewer_reaction, then realize it in final copy by placing the specific surprising claim against its consequence. Never literally output 外资策略师、外资首席、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话, or 西方机构承认.
- words_vs_actions: use only when research.words_vs_actions.supported is true and independent_source_count is at least 2. Show the two exact sides in question form. Never directly call anyone a liar.
- china_advantage: use only when research.china_advantage.supported is true. Put the concrete Chinese advantage or the foreign competitor's forced response in the foreground. The emotional direction must favor China.
- authority_breaks_consensus: the authority must be recognizable to a China audience, or be labeled by a meaningful role. Do not lead with an obscure romanized name.
- concrete_stakes: expose a specific number, forced choice, consequence, or who gains/loses. Generic importance is not a stake.

Writing rules:
- Style: factual clickbait for China finance audience
- Produce exactly four candidates per clip and use at least three different angle_id values when the evidence permits.
- Each candidate has exactly three short title lines. Think cover blocks, not a newspaper sentence.
- Ideal line lengths are 3-10, 4-12, and 5-14 Chinese characters. Full title is ideally 10-24 Chinese characters.
- The title must reveal enough familiar context to create a small information gap, then withhold the explanation supplied by the video.
- Prefer concrete verbs and consequences: 逼急、藏不住、说透、砍半. Use only when facts support them. "改口" requires research.position_change.supported with two independent sources; words-versus-actions phrases require research.words_vs_actions.supported with two independent sources.
- Do not mechanically copy examples or proper nouns from instructions. Derive every noun, number, actor, and comparison from this clip and its evidence card.
- angle_id, emotion_pole, and viewer_reaction are private editorial metadata. Never copy their wording into title or title_lines.
- Final cover structure should be [specific subject] / [unexpected fact or comparison] / [concrete unresolved consequence], not [speaker category] / [editorial label] / [topic].
- If a person or institution is genuinely recognizable, use its verified proper name. If it is not recognizable, omit the identity and lead with the subject and fact; do not replace it with generic labels such as 外资策略师 or 海外专家.
- For names and technical terms, use only the current clip's verified title_label. Never use official_zh/legal company names as cover copy, and never invent a Chinese transliteration when title_label is empty or English.
- Bloomberg/Bloomberg LP/彭博社 is a source label, not the expert or actor. Company legal suffixes do not belong in a title.
- For China-related clips, never attack China or imply national decline. Favor confidence, competence, policy room, industrial strength, cost advantage, talent, resilience, and competitors being forced to respond.
- If the clip is negative about China and no constructive factual angle exists, use a neutral mechanism question instead of nationalist or doom framing.
- Forbidden title words: 资产管理、投资、股票、基金、理财、保险、投顾、荐股、买入、卖出.
- Forbidden hard-negative wording: 经济危机、金融危机、债务危机、危机、崩盘、崩溃、完了、没救、惨了.
- Do not use sensitive geopolitical or military subjects, emojis, markdown, quotation marks, hashtags, or numbered prefixes.
- If evidence cannot support four dramatic factual claims, vary the framing and use strong questions; never fabricate the missing drama.

Tournament procedure, perform in this order:
1. Evidence veto: reject candidates that use a name, number, consensus, public action, comparison, or accusation not supported by that clip's transcript/research card.
2. China direction veto: for China-related clips, reject any candidate whose emotional target is China, Chinese people, Chinese companies, or China's future. Comparative pride is allowed only when supported.
3. Neutrality veto: reject flat summaries and generic questions. A question mark alone does not create tension.
4. Meta-copy veto: reject titles that expose the editor's reasoning with labels such as 外资策略师、外资首席、海外专家、西方策略师、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话、 or 西方机构承认. The viewer should feel the effect from the facts, not be told how to feel.
5. Audience test: complete exactly one sentence: "看完标题，观众第一反应是____". If the answer is merely "我知道发生了什么", reject it.
6. Score survivors from 0-10. Final requires emotion_tension >= 8, novelty >= 7, specificity >= 7, curiosity_gap >= 7, factual_fidelity >= 9. For China clips, china_resonance >= 8.
7. Select the winner or combine only two candidates. If no candidate passes, write one new title, then score it honestly.
8. Before returning, verify every quality_check field. If any is false, rewrite once. Never return a known failure.

Editorial interpretation:
- 二极管 means one high-activation pole, not random anger: 意外, 惊喜, 强疑惑, 终于有人说, 有证据的言行反差, or 民族自豪.
- 新鲜感 requires a baseline plus a reversal. "外资谈中国" is ordinary; "外资在普遍悲观时罕见给出积极判断" is a usable reversal only if public_baseline supports it.
- 大实话 comes from who said what and why that identity makes the candor surprising. Do not paste "大实话" onto a routine forecast.
- 大实话、终于有人说、反差质疑 and 民族自豪 describe the intended viewer response internally. Do not print those labels or their editorial scaffolding in the title. Express them through the specific fact, comparison, and consequence.
- The desired effect of a possible falsehood angle is factual suspicion, not a verdict. Only when words_vs_actions is verified may you use a question such as "嘴上X，手里却Y？".
- "改口" means the same actor demonstrably held a different prior position. It requires research.position_change.supported and at least two independent sources. Never infer a change from search-result absence, lack of prior coverage, or a vague reputation.
- 民族自豪 comes from a concrete comparison: cost, technology, talent, supply chain, demand, speed, resilience, or a foreign competitor's forced adjustment. Do not use empty slogans.
- Familiar authority helps. Use a verified proper name only when the audience is likely to recognize it. Otherwise lead with the concrete subject; generic editorial identities such as 外资策略师、海外专家 or 西方策略师 are not final copy.
- Bloomberg/Bloomberg LP/彭博社 is normally the source, never the guest. Do not output 彭博有限合伙企业.
- Use only verified title_label values from this clip's entity/term card. Do not expand a familiar short name into a formal full name, and do not borrow an entity from another clip.

current_title_lines: 阿里云增速上调，美团预期过高

subtitles.zh: 腾讯只是中国科技财报季的开始。其他公司方面，您最关注什么？这次投资者最需要留意什么？
subtitles.en: Okay, Tencent is just the beginning of this whole China Tech earnings season. Let's talk about the others. What are you watching out for the most for the rest of it? What do you think investors need to look out for the most this time?

subtitles.zh: 下周有阿里和百度，两家都会展示云收入增长方面的算力。
subtitles.en: Next week, obviously, we have Baba, and then we have Baidu. Both of them will also show, you know, the compute powers, like in terms of their cloud revenue growth.

subtitles.zh: 阿里方面，我们预览中将云收入预期上调至45%，较上季的38%加速。
subtitles.en: Baba, in our preview, we raise our cloud revenue estimate to 45%, so they are accelerating from 38% last quarter.

subtitles.zh: 希望他们能实现。百度上季AI云收入已增长79%，本季我们预计62%，略有放缓，部分因上季基数高。
subtitles.en: So hopefully, they're going to achieve that. And then for Baidu, last quarter, they already achieved like 80%, like 79%, on the AI cloud info revenue.

subtitles.zh: 本季我们预计62%，略有放缓，部分因上季基数高。之后是美团，虽未公布日期，但许多客户近期关注。为什么？
subtitles.en: So this quarter, we model 62, is slightly salary, partly because, you know, last quarter is so high. And then after that, then we have, Maituan hasn't announced the reporting date, but Maituan is also another name that a lot of clients actu

subtitles.zh: 部分因为6月底低点后反弹强劲，盈利上修明显。
subtitles.en: Well, partly because I think, you know, their bounce back really, you know, well, on to the from the load in end of June, partly because of the earnings revisions is very clear.

subtitles.zh: 但我持谨慎态度，三季报指引的预期已非常高。
subtitles.en: But I'm actually would be cautious. I think the expectation is going building very high into the 3Q guidance as well.

subtitles.zh: 有迹象表明价格战正在缓和吗？您是否看到更多信号？您是指广告方面？
subtitles.en: Okay. Any indication that those price wars are something of a passive? Yeah. Are you starting to see more signs of that? You mean the more advertising wall?

subtitles.zh: 电商领域，这些业务实际表现如何？广告等。
subtitles.en: Yeah. E-commerce space. How do these businesses actually look? Advertising and all these things.

subtitles.zh: 外卖定价压力已过，因此阿里电商、美团甚至今晚的京东盈利都在修复。
subtitles.en: Yeah. So the food delivery pricing more is behind us. Okay. That's why you see the earnings recovery for Baba on the commerce side, for Maituan and even for JD, which is tonight.

subtitles.zh: 但电商方面，宏观环境仍偏弱。
subtitles.en: And then on the commerce, unfortunately, the big pictures, the macros remain quite weak.

subtitles.zh: 因此阿里等平台的GMV和CMR增长仍承压。
subtitles.en: So that will still wait on, you know, the GMV and the CMR growth for Baba, for example.

subtitles.zh: 云服务价格战方面，腾讯昨日提到，他们似乎也能提价。
subtitles.en: Yeah. And then the cloud pricing war, I think Tencent talked about yesterday. It seems like they are also able to raise prices.

subtitles.zh: 并非所有厂商都在压价，他们可以利用更高投入成本来提高云产品价格。
subtitles.en: So it's not like, you know, really that everyone is driving down the prices. Indeed, you know, they can use the higher input cost to actually raise their cloud product costs.

subtitles.zh: 本周我们与嘉宾讨论，市场看待中国大型科技股的方式似乎正在转变。
subtitles.en: We've been talking to our guests this week about, this seems to be a sea change of how people are looking at trying a big tech now.

Tournament procedure, perform in this order:
1. Evidence veto: reject candidates that use a name, number, consensus, public action, comparison, or accusation not supported by that clip's transcript/research card.
2. China direction veto: for China-related clips, reject any candidate whose emotional target is China, Chinese people, Chinese companies, or China's future. Comparative pride is allowed only when supported.
3. Neutrality veto: reject flat summaries and generic questions. A question mark alone does not create tension.
4. Meta-copy veto: reject titles that expose the editor's reasoning with labels such as 外资策略师、外资首席、海外专家、西方策略师、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话、 or 西方机构承认. The viewer should feel the effect from the facts, not be told how to feel.
5. Audience test: complete exactly one sentence: "看完标题，观众第一反应是____". If the answer is merely "我知道发生了什么", reject it.
6. Score survivors from 0-10. Final requires emotion_tension >= 8, novelty >= 7, specificity >= 7, curiosity_gap >= 7, factual_fidelity >= 9. For China clips, china_resonance >= 8.
7. Select the winner or combine only two candidates. If no candidate passes, write one new title, then score it honestly.
8. Before returning, verify every quality_check field. If any is false, rewrite once. Never return a known failure.

Editorial interpretation:
- 二极管 means one high-activation pole, not random anger: 意外, 惊喜, 强疑惑, 终于有人说, 有证据的言行反差, or 民族自豪.
- 新鲜感 requires a baseline plus a reversal. "外资谈中国" is ordinary; "外资在普遍悲观时罕见给出积极判断" is a usable reversal only if public_baseline supports it.
- 大实话 comes from who said what and why that identity makes the candor surprising. Do not paste "大实话" onto a routine forecast.
- 大实话、终于有人说、反差质疑 and 民族自豪 describe the intended viewer response internally. Do not print those labels or their editorial scaffolding in the title. Express them through the specific fact, comparison, and consequence.
- The desired effect of a possible falsehood angle is factual suspicion, not a verdict. Only when words_vs_actions is verified may you use a question such as "嘴上X，手里却Y？".
- "改口" means the same actor demonstrably held a different prior position. It requires research.position_change.supported and at least two independent sources. Never infer a change from search-result absence, lack of prior coverage, or a vague reputation.
- 民族自豪 comes from a concrete comparison: cost, technology, talent, supply chain, demand, speed, resilience, or a foreign competitor's forced adjustment. Do not use empty slogans.
- Familiar authority helps. Use a verified proper name only when the audience is likely to recognize it. Otherwise lead with the concrete subject; generic editorial identities such as 外资策略师、海外专家 or 西方策略师 are not final copy.
- Bloomberg/Bloomberg LP/彭博社 is normally the source, never the guest. Do not output 彭博有限合伙企业.

briefs.speaker: Tracy Chen
briefs.speaker_context: Portfolio Manager at Brandywine Global
briefs.current_title: 通胀数据符合预期，美联储9月加息仍难？

subtitles.zh: 我认为今天的通胀数据符合市场预期。
subtitles.en: Yeah, I think today's inflation number is just as people expected.

subtitles.zh: 整体和核心通胀都如此，所以对我来说几乎没什么影响。
subtitles.en: It is like both the headline and core inflation. So to me, it's almost like a non-event, right?

subtitles.zh: 起初市场反应剧烈，债市和股市都上涨，但收盘时涨幅大多回落。
subtitles.en: Initially, the market reacted sharply, cherry rallied and equity rallied, but at the market close, most of the move already faded.

subtitles.zh: 这说明市场真正担心的不是通胀。近期债市抛售主要受实际收益率驱动，通胀预期一直很稳定。
subtitles.en: So that shows you the market real concern is not inflation. Most of the cherry sell off recently is driven by real yield, or term premium inflation break even has been very stable.

subtitles.zh: 所以我认为美联储会感到一些宽慰，但这并不是债市抛售的真正原因。美联储在应对通胀方面仍落后于曲线。
subtitles.en: So I would characterize that the Fed should feel some kind of relief, but that's not a real story behind the cherry sell off. And the Fed is still behind the curve on tackling inflation and to reach their inflation target.

subtitles.zh: 所以我认为这不会增加他们加息的可能性。
subtitles.en: So I think this will not make them more likely to hike.

subtitles.zh: 所以我认为美联储在9月加息很难，因为临近中期选举，但同时你希望他们7月就该加息，因为通胀仍然偏高。
subtitles.en: So I think it's really hard for the Fed to hike in September, because it's so close to midterm, but at the same time, you hope that they should have hiked in July, right? Because inflation is still elevated, yeah.

subtitles.zh: 如果你看仓位，目前人们普遍低配久期。
subtitles.en: Yeah, I think if you look at the positioning, the CDA positioning, people are underweight duration right now.

subtitles.zh: 所以回补低配并不需要太多推动，短期内美债可能有所反弹。
subtitles.en: So it doesn't take a lot for people to cover their underweight. So I think in a near-term treasury can have a bit of a rally.

subtitles.zh: 但我认为反弹不会持续太久。因此拍卖应该会顺利，因为人们仓位太轻。
subtitles.en: But I don't think that will last long. So, hence, I think the auction should go well, because of the simple fact that people are so underweight.

subtitles.zh: 而且市场对加息概率的定价较低，所以两年期收益率可能比30年期反弹更多。
subtitles.en: And I think they were priced less, a probability of hike. So you can see two-year can rally more than 30-year.

subtitles.zh: 短期内你会看到曲线陡峭化，无论是熊陡还是牛陡。但总会有某种陡峭化来逐步消化9月加息预期。
subtitles.en: You will see a curve steepening in a near-term, either bare-steepening or a boost-steepening. But there should be some kind of a steepening to gradually price out of the September hike.

briefs.speaker: Tracy Chen
briefs.speaker_context: Portfolio Manager at Brandywine Global
briefs.current_title: AI资本开支巨大，信用利差或继续走阔

subtitles.zh: 我认为供给太多，市场对AI交易存在怀疑。
subtitles.en: I think there's just too much supply, and there's a skepticism on the AI trade.

subtitles.zh: 但看全球AI竞赛，中美之间谁先放缓都很难说。
subtitles.en: But if you look at the global AI arms race between China and the US, it's quite daunting to see which one will slow down.

subtitles.zh: 所以美国的大型云厂商被迫持续扩建基础设施，因为算力需求仍然巨大。
subtitles.en: So I think the hyperscaler in the US, they are forced to just keep building out the infrastructure because the demand for compute is still very huge.

subtitles.zh: 看核心企业的财报，显示他们积压订单非常多。
subtitles.en: And if you look at the core beef, the earnings report, it shows that they have so many backlogs.

subtitles.zh: 同时，我认为信用市场将不得不吸收大量供给。
subtitles.en: So at the same time, I do think the credit market will have to absorb a lot of supply.

subtitles.zh: 这就是为什么我认为信用利差会继续走阔，尤其是投资级部分。
subtitles.en: That is why I think the credit spread will continue to widen from here, especially the IG part.

subtitles.zh: 对于配置者来说，我们必须挑选债券。数据中心信用并非都一样，它们的交易表现也不同。
subtitles.en: And for investors, we have to pick bonds, right? All data center credit are created equal. You can see them trade differently.

subtitles.zh: 配置者关心的是未来哪个会胜出。
subtitles.en: It's the investor's concern about which one will be going forward.

subtitles.zh: 摩根大通估计，从现在到2030年，云厂商的AI建设支出将达到5万亿美元。
subtitles.en: So I think JP Morgan estimated there will be $5 trillion of KPACs spending from hyperscalers, so the entire AI built out from now to 2030.

subtitles.zh: 大部分支出将落在投资级信用、私募信用和高收益债上，证券化只占很小部分。
subtitles.en: And most of the spending will fall IG credit and private credit and high yield and securitize a tiny part of that 5 trillion.

subtitles.zh: 所以资本需求巨大，这正是我认为资本成本会上升的原因。
subtitles.en: So that's a lot of demand for capital. And that is exactly why I think the cost of capital will go up.

subtitles.zh: 你可以把这看作AI公司的财政刺激。我们正从政府财政刺激转向私营部门的财政刺激。
subtitles.en: You can view this as a fiscal stimulus from AI company. So we are going from a government fiscal stimulus to private sector, fiscal stimulus.

subtitles.zh: 信用利差会从这里继续走阔，这只是供给问题。
subtitles.en: Credit spread, well, well, widen from here, just a matter of supply.

briefs.current_title: 后疫情时代资本成本上升，主权债承压
current_title_lines: 后疫情时代资本成本上升

subtitles.zh: 我一直在观察疫情前后的体制变化。
subtitles.en: Yeah, I think I have been witnessing this regime change pre-COVID versus post-COVID.

subtitles.zh: 疫情前储蓄过剩、配置不足，资本成本极低，甚至实际收益率接近零或为负。
subtitles.en: So pre-COVID, we have so many savings and then you don't have enough investment. So the cost of capital is so low, we have adsorb or actually negative real, real yield.

subtitles.zh: 但疫情后，政府支出巨大，财富从政府部门转移到私营部门。
subtitles.en: But post-COVID, we have massive government spending and there's a wealth transfer from government sector to private sector.

subtitles.zh: 家庭锁定了很低的按揭利率，企业也通过再融资获得很低的资本成本。
subtitles.en: Household has been locking very low mortgage rate and corporate. They have been refined refinance their debt to get very low cost of capital.

subtitles.zh: 所以现在我们对家庭和企业部门较为乐观，但对主权债尤其是发达市场主权债持谨慎态度，因为财政状况不佳。
subtitles.en: So right now we are very constructive on both households and corporate and less. Or I can say negative on the sovereign, especially DM sovereign because the fiscal picture is just very ugly.

subtitles.zh: 所以我们对信用债比主权债更乐观。我认为收益率将保持高位，甚至可能更高。
subtitles.en: So I would say we are more constructive on credit rather than the DM sovereigns. I think yield will stay high for longer if not going higher for longer.

subtitles.zh: 通胀也会保持高位，因为财政支出太多。
subtitles.en: And inflation will also be elevated because there are just too much fiscal spending.

briefs.speaker: Alicia Yapp
briefs.speaker_context: Citi Group Global Markets, Asia MD and Head of Pan-Asia Internet Research
briefs.current_title: 花旗杨霭仪：AI资本开支大超预期，腾讯三年投入6000亿

subtitles.zh: 可以理解，因为金额确实很大。
subtitles.en: Well, it is understandable, given it is a really big amount.

subtitles.zh: 本季度增幅很大。我最初的反应是，他们终于能花钱了。
subtitles.en: It's a big jump, right, this quarter. I think my initial reaction is that, oh, they're actually able to spend.

subtitles.zh: 因为之前他们一直说要投入，只是没在合适的时间花出去。
subtitles.en: Because previously, I think they've been talking about the one or two spend. It's just that they couldn't spend it on the right time, right?

subtitles.zh: 但现在，他们终于能采购到内存芯片或部分国产GPU了。
subtitles.en: But now, I think finally, they're able to procure, I think the delivery of either the memory chips or some of the GPU from the domestic side.

subtitles.zh: 这推高了资本开支，也产生了预付款以确保采购。
subtitles.en: This is probably prompting the cap expense number and also the prepayment to secure some of the procurements.

subtitles.zh: 这也导致本季度现金流流出。
subtitles.en: It's also results in the outflow for the cash flow this quarter.

subtitles.zh: 这很可能不是一次性的资本开支。
subtitles.en: It's likely not a one-off cap expense.

subtitles.zh: 本季度后我们上调了资本开支假设。
subtitles.en: So we raised our Quebec's assumption post this quarter.

subtitles.zh: 之前我们过于保守，因为过去几个季度没看到实际投入。
subtitles.en: Previously, we were way too conservative, given we haven't seen anything that coming in right the past few quarter.

subtitles.zh: 我们现在预计2026年及未来两个季度，资本开支将从530亿上调至650亿。
subtitles.en: So we are now for 2026, even for the next two quarters, we are raising a 260, 65 billion coming out from the 53 billion.

subtitles.zh: 所以今年我们预计为2000亿。
subtitles.en: So our this year, four year, we are at 200 billion.

subtitles.zh: 未来两年也将超过2000亿。
subtitles.en: And then next two year, we are also above 200 billion.

subtitles.zh: 这意味着未来三年总计约6000亿。
subtitles.en: So that means the next three years, we are actually total about 600 billion.

subtitles.zh: 在AI投入变现路径尚不明朗时，自由现金流转为负值，您是否担忧？还是您有不同的看法？
subtitles.en: Is it concerning that they're basically trading free cash for negative at a time when that pathway to monetization on these AI investments is still maybe not as clear or do you see it a bit differently?

subtitles.zh: 这只是一个季度，但要看他们能产生的营业利润。
subtitles.en: This is only one quarter, but if you look at the operating profit, they're able to generate.

subtitles.zh: 全年营业利润超过3000亿。
subtitles.en: So it's actually over 300 billion, full year, on the full year basis.

subtitles.zh: 所以有时只是单季度影响，因为他们需要预付款。
subtitles.en: So sometimes it's just a one quarter impact because they have to prepay.

subtitles.zh: 例如，如果要签合同，客户要求预付款，你就得预付以确保。
subtitles.en: So for example, if you wanted to sign certain contracts and your customer asked you to prepay, you have to prepay to secure.

subtitles.zh: 所以我认为这只是部分流出的时点问题。
subtitles.en: So I actually think it's just a timing of some of the outflow.

subtitles.zh: 但全年来看，核心业务仍能产生可观的经营现金流。
subtitles.en: But on the full year basis, there are core businesses still generating decent operating cash flow.

subtitles.zh: 所以无需融资。
subtitles.en: So no need to raise money.

subtitles.zh: 他们有一些现有债务。
subtitles.en: They have some existing debt.

subtitles.zh: 我们显然不知道他们怎么想。
subtitles.en: We obviously don't know what they're thinking about it.

subtitles.zh: 但如果需要，他们可以进入债务市场，而且他们还有投资组合，必要时可以出售。
subtitles.en: But if they want, they can tap into the debt market and not that. And then they also have the investment portfolio that they can also sell down if they really need it.

subtitles.zh: 您是否清楚，虽然可能是长期故事，但会有新的收入来源出现？
subtitles.en: Is it clear to you, and it could be a longer term story, but is it clear to you that there will be fresh and new revenue streams coming through?

subtitles.zh: 因为所有这些投入，或者人们会花更多时间。
subtitles.en: Because of all the investments that, or is it, you know, people are going to be spending more time.

subtitles.zh: AI故事的规模效应何时开始显现？
subtitles.en: When does their scale start to show up, basically, the AI story?

subtitles.zh: 元宝已经是他们以前没有的新收入来源。
subtitles.en: What buddy is already a new revenue stream that they don't have before?

subtitles.zh: 它实际上可以按token收费。
subtitles.en: This is actually able to charge based on the token.

subtitles.zh: 至于小微，消费者AI，说实话，我认为目前还没有清晰的变现路线图。
subtitles.en: And then I think the Xiaowei, the consumer AI, to be honest, I don't think there is a clear roadmap in terms of the actual new monetization.

subtitles.zh: 但随着时间的推移，因为每个人每天都用微信，所以会增强现有的变现能力，
subtitles.en: But over time, I think when, because everybody is using WeChat every day, so it's going to be enhanced the existing monetization,

subtitles.zh: 包括游戏、广告或支付机制，如交易。
subtitles.en: which is either the gaming, the advertising, or the payment mechanism, like the transaction.

subtitles.zh: 这些将是对现有业务的补充。
subtitles.en: So those will be the additions of the existing business.

subtitles.zh: 他们还提到，未来如果拥有算力，他们也在考虑GPU租赁业务。
subtitles.en: And then, you know, they talk about into the future if they have access, compute power, they are thinking about also the renting GPU business, right?

subtitles.zh: 这将通过他们的云业务实现。
subtitles.en: Which will through their cloud business, okay?

subtitles.zh: 然后模型即服务，一旦混元4足够强大，
subtitles.en: And then the model as a service, once their, let's say, Hunyuan 4 becomes good enough, strong enough model,

subtitles.zh: 他们就能加强模型即服务平台，并从中产生收入。
subtitles.en: they could also strengthen their model as a service platform, which they could also generate revenue from there.

briefs.speaker: Alicia Yap
briefs.speaker_context: Managing Director and Head of Pan-Asia Internet Research at Citigroup Global Markets Asia
briefs.current_title: 花旗杨霭蔚：外卖价格战缓和，云服务提价成新趋势
current_title_lines: 外卖价格战缓和，云服务提价

subtitles.zh: 有迹象表明价格战正在缓和吗？您是否看到更多信号？您是指广告方面？
subtitles.en: Okay. Any indication that those price wars are something of a passive? Yeah. Are you starting to see more signs of that? You mean the more advertising wall?

subtitles.zh: 电商领域，这些业务实际表现如何？广告等。
subtitles.en: Yeah. E-commerce space. How do these businesses actually look? Advertising and all these things.

subtitles.zh: 外卖定价压力已过，因此阿里电商、美团甚至今晚的京东盈利都在修复。
subtitles.en: Yeah. So the food delivery pricing more is behind us. Okay. That's why you see the earnings recovery for Baba on the commerce side, for Maituan and even for JD, which is tonight.

subtitles.zh: 但电商方面，宏观环境仍偏弱。
subtitles.en: And then on the commerce, unfortunately, the big pictures, the macros remain quite weak.

subtitles.zh: 因此阿里等平台的GMV和CMR增长仍承压。
subtitles.en: So that will still wait on, you know, the GMV and the CMR growth for Baba, for example.

subtitles.zh: 云服务价格战方面，腾讯昨日提到，他们似乎也能提价。
subtitles.en: Yeah. And then the cloud pricing war, I think Tencent talked about yesterday. It seems like they are also able to raise prices.

subtitles.zh: 并非所有厂商都在压价，他们可以利用更高投入成本来提高云产品价格。
subtitles.en: So it's not like, you know, really that everyone is driving down the prices. Indeed, you know, they can use the higher input cost to actually raise their cloud product costs.

subtitles.zh: 本周我们与嘉宾讨论，市场看待中国大型科技股的方式似乎正在转变。
subtitles.en: We've been talking to our guests this week about, this seems to be a sea change of how people are looking at trying a big tech now.
